question.q: She bought dresses, shoes, and cosmetics all in the same ________.
question.justification: المتجر الشامل (department store) يبيع الملابس وغيرها. المخبز (bakery) للخبز، والصيدلية (pharmacy) للأدوية، والمرأب (garage) للسيارات.
question.context_sentence: She bought dresses, shoes, and cosmetics all in the same ________.

question.q: The smell of fresh bread drew customers into the ________ early in the morning.
question.justification: الخبز الطازج من المخبز (bakery). البنك (bank) للمال، والصيدلية (pharmacy) للدواء، والمكتبة (library) للكتب.
question.context_sentence: The smell of fresh bread drew customers into the ________ early in the morning.

question.q: I need to stop at the ________ to pick up shampoo and toothpaste.
question.justification: أدوات النظافة الشخصية (toiletries) تُباع في الصيدلية/محل الأدوات (drugstore). المخبز (bakery) للخبز، والمكتبة (bookstore) للكتب، والمصنع (factory) للإنتاج.
question.context_sentence: I need to stop at the ________ to pick up shampoo and toothpaste.

question.q: He spent hours browsing the shelves of the ________ looking for a good novel.
question.justification: الروايات تُشترى من متجر الكتب (bookstore). المخبز (bakery) للخبز، وصيدلية الأدوات (drugstore) لأدوات النظافة، والمطعم (restaurant) للطعام.
question.context_sentence: He spent hours browsing the shelves of the ________ looking for a good novel.

question.q: The children used bright ________ to color the pictures in their drawing books.
question.justification: الأطفال يرسمون بالألوان الشمعية (crayons). الطبول (drums) للعزف، والمفرقعات (crackers) للألعاب النارية، والسرطانات (crabs) حيوانات بحرية.
question.context_sentence: The children used bright ________ to color the pictures in their drawing books.

question.q: One important ________ of learning a language is practicing every day.
question.justification: قواعد السلامة تنطبق على كل جانب (aspect) من جوانب الحياة. الإحصاء (statistic) رقم، والرياضة (sport) نشاط، والرسوم الدراسية (tuition) تكلفة تعليم.
question.context_sentence: One important ________ of learning a language is practicing every day.

question.q: Cities like Tokyo and London rely heavily on ________ to move millions of people daily.
question.justification: النقل العام (mass transit) هو الأفضل في المدن المزدحمة. الفردية (individualism) عكس ذلك، وضغط الأقران (peer pressure) ظاهرة اجتماعية، والمنتجات (produce) سلع.
question.context_sentence: Cities like Tokyo and London rely heavily on ________ to move millions of people daily.

question.q: Every ________ of the building must show an ID card to enter.
question.justification: سكان المدينة (residents) يستخدمون النقل العام. المستهلكون (consumers) عامة، والجوانب (aspects) زوايا، والأساليب (methods) طرق.
question.context_sentence: Every ________ of the building must show an ID card to enter.

question.q: She has a very ________ mind and is always coming up with new inventions.
question.justification: المخترع لديه عقل مبدع (creative). الريفي (rural) للريف، والثقافي (cultural) للثقافة، والصناعي (industrial) للصناعة.
question.context_sentence: She has a very ________ mind and is always coming up with new inventions.

question.q: The charity received a generous donation from an ________ donor.
question.justification: الرسالة كانت مجهولة (anonymous) بدون اسم. المساواة (egalitarian) عدالة، والمهني (vocational) تدريب، والغني (affluent) ثري.
question.context_sentence: The charity received a generous donation from an ________ donor.

question.q: A runny nose is a common ________ of a cold.
question.justification: الحمى عرض (symptom) من أعراض الإنفلونزا. السبب (cause) هو الفيروس، والعلاج (cure) هو الدواء، والمرض (disease) هو الحالة المرضية نفسها.
question.context_sentence: A runny nose is a common ________ of a cold.

question.q: The cyclist had to stop because a nail caused a ________ in the front tire.
question.justification: ثقب الإطار (puncture) تسبب في الحادث. الانفجار (explosion) أكبر، والتصميم (design) والتوجيه (engine) ليسا سببين مباشرين.
question.context_sentence: The cyclist had to stop because a nail caused a ________ in the front tire.

question.q: The ________ at the chemical plant was heard several kilometers away.
question.justification: انفجار المصنع (explosion) قتل العمال. التجربة (experiment) اختبار، والري (irrigation) سقاية، والسكان (population) عدد الناس.
question.context_sentence: The ________ at the chemical plant was heard several kilometers away.

question.q: The system ________ saves your work every five minutes, so you won't lose data.
question.justification: الآلة تتوقف تلقائياً (automatically). يدوياً (manually) تحتاج تدخلاً بشرياً، وببطء (slowly) وبصوت عالٍ (loudly) تصف الكيفية وليس الآلية.
question.context_sentence: The system ________ saves your work every five minutes, so you won't lose data.

question.q: The teacher will not ________ any form of cheating during the exam.
question.justification: لا أستطيع تحمل (tolerate) السلوك السيئ. الاستمتاع (enjoy) والثناء (praise) والتجاهل (ignore) مواقف أخرى.
question.context_sentence: The teacher will not ________ any form of cheating during the exam.

question.q: Speeding is a serious ________ of traffic laws and can result in a heavy fine.
question.justification: الوقوف هنا مخالفة (violation). الاحتفال (celebration) والتعليم (education) والحالة (situation) لا تعبر عن شيء مخالف للقانون.
question.context_sentence: Speeding is a serious ________ of traffic laws and can result in a heavy fine.

question.q: Our final ________ is a beautiful island off the coast of Greece.
question.justification: غيرت الطائرة وجهتها (destination). المحرك (engine) والسرعة (speed) واللون (color) ليست ما يتغير غالباً.
question.context_sentence: Our final ________ is a beautiful island off the coast of Greece.

question.q: Football is more than just a sport in Brazil; it's a national ________.
question.justification: الرغبي هوس وطني (obsession) في نيوزيلندا. اللعبة (game) والرياضة (sport) والهواية (hobby) لا تعبر عن الشغف الجماهيري الكبير.
question.context_sentence: Football is more than just a sport in Brazil; it's a national ________.

question.q: The national ________ of Canada is the maple leaf.
question.justification: شعار (emblem) فريق All Blacks هو السرخس الفضي. العلم (flag) شيء آخر، والكرة (ball) أداة اللعب، والأغنية (song) ليست شعاراً.
question.context_sentence: The national ________ of Canada is the maple leaf.

question.q: After the eruption, a large ________ was formed where the mountain once stood.
question.justification: بركان تامبورا ترك فوهة بركانية ضخمة (caldera). الجبل (mountain) والنهر (river) والغابة (forest) ليست ما يخلفه البركان.
question.context_sentence: After the eruption, a large ________ was formed where the mountain once stood.

question.q: Jet planes often fly in the lower part of the ________, where the air is thin and stable.
question.justification: الرماد قذف إلى الستراتوسفير (stratosphere). المحيط (ocean) والأرض (ground) والمدينة (city) ليست طبقات الغلاف الجوي.
question.context_sentence: Jet planes often fly in the lower part of the ________, where the air is thin and stable.

question.q: The war and drought led to widespread ________, with millions suffering from hunger.
question.justification: فشل المحاصيل يسبب مجاعة (famine). الوليمة (feast) عكسها، والفيضان (flood) والنار (fire) كوارث مختلفة.
question.context_sentence: The war and drought led to widespread ________, with millions suffering from hunger.

question.q: Scientists are working on ________ travel that would allow humans to visit Mars.
question.justification: السفر بين الكواكب (interplanetary) هو الحدود التالية. المحلي (domestic) وداخل الأرض (underground) والبحري (submarine) ليست طموحات الفضاء.
question.context_sentence: Scientists are working on ________ travel that would allow humans to visit Mars.

question.q: The ________ company developed a new vaccine in record time.
question.justification: شركات الأدوية (pharmaceutical) تطور أدوية جديدة. السيارات (automotive) والنسيج (textile) والبناء (construction) صناعات أخرى.
question.context_sentence: The ________ company developed a new vaccine in record time.

question.q: The ________ of the cathedral is decorated with magnificent stone carvings.
question.justification: واجهة المبنى (facade) مذهلة. الحديقة (garden) والقبو (basement) والسقف (roof) أجزاء أخرى من المبنى.
question.context_sentence: The ________ of the cathedral is decorated with magnificent stone carvings.

question.q: The neighboring country ________ the disputed territory after a long conflict.
question.justification: تم ضم الإقليم (annexed) بالقوة. التحرير (liberated) عكس الضم، والتجاهل (ignored) والإنشاء (created) لا يتوافقان مع القوة.
question.context_sentence: The neighboring country ________ the disputed territory after a long conflict.

question.q: The ________ of several small companies created one large corporation.
question.justification: توطيد الذاكرة (consolidation) يحدث أثناء النوم. التدمير (destruction) والارتباك (confusion) والمحو (erasure) عكس ذلك.
question.context_sentence: The ________ of several small companies created one large corporation.

question.q: Sensory ________ can lead to hallucinations as the brain tries to create its own stimulation.
question.justification: الحرمان من النوم (deprivation) يضر الإدراك. الزيادة (excess) والإضافة (addition) والمكمل (supplement) لا تعبر عن نقص النوم.
question.context_sentence: Sensory ________ can lead to hallucinations as the brain tries to create its own stimulation.

question.q: Reading and solving puzzles are excellent ways to maintain ________ health.
question.justification: المهارات المعرفية (cognitive) تتراجع مع العمر. الجسدية (physical) والعضلية (muscular) والهيكلية (skeletal) تتأثر أيضاً لكن السؤال يركز على العقل.
question.context_sentence: Reading and solving puzzles are excellent ways to maintain ________ health.

question.q: The nuclear reactor is surrounded by heavy ________ to prevent radiation leaks.
question.justification: التدريع (shielding) ضروري للسفر الفضائي. الطبخ (cooking) والتزيين (decorating) والإضاءة (lighting) ليست من مستلزمات الفضاء.
question.context_sentence: The nuclear reactor is surrounded by heavy ________ to prevent radiation leaks.

question.q: The castle was ________ built on top of a hill to provide a clear view of approaching enemies.
question.justification: البتراء كانت موقعاً استراتيجياً (strategically). عشوائياً (randomly) وسيئاً (poorly) وحديثاً (recently) لا تصف موقعها التاريخي.
question.context_sentence: The castle was ________ built on top of a hill to provide a clear view of approaching enemies.

question.q: She suffers from ________ back pain that never really goes away.
question.justification: الأمراض المزمنة (chronic) تستمر طويلاً. الحادة (acute) مفاجئة، والمؤقتة (temporary) والخفيفة (mild) عكس ذلك.
question.context_sentence: She suffers from ________ back pain that never really goes away.

question.q: Many people prefer ________ teas to regular tea because they are natural and caffeine-free.
question.justification: العلاجات العشبية (herbal) تستخدم النباتات. الكيميائية (chemical) والاصطناعية (synthetic) والمعدنية (metallic) لا تعتمد على النباتات مباشرة.
question.context_sentence: Many people prefer ________ teas to regular tea because they are natural and caffeine-free.

question.q: Before testifying in court, the witness must take an ________ to tell the truth.
question.justification: الأطباء يؤدون قسماً مهنياً (oath). الكتاب (book) والدواء (medicine) والاختبار (test) ليست ما يؤدى.
question.context_sentence: Before testifying in court, the witness must take an ________ to tell the truth.

question.q: The nurse applied an ________ to the cut before putting on the bandage.
question.justification: تنظف الجروح بالمطهر (antiseptic). المسكن (analgesic) للألم، والمضاد الحيوي (antibiotic) للبكتيريا، والمضاد الفيروسي (antiviral) للفيروسات.
question.context_sentence: The nurse applied an ________ to the cut before putting on the bandage.

question.q: The company is committed to using ________ materials that do not harm the environment.
question.justification: الحلول المستدامة (sustainable) تحمي الكوكب. المؤقتة (temporary) والغالية (expensive) والخطيرة (dangerous) لا تفيد البيئة.
question.context_sentence: The company is committed to using ________ materials that do not harm the environment.

question.q: In ________ farming, plants grow in a nutrient-rich water solution without any soil.
question.justification: الزراعة المائية (hydroponic) لا تحتاج تربة. العضوية (organic) والتقليدية (traditional) واليدوية (manual) قد تستخدم التربة.
question.context_sentence: In ________ farming, plants grow in a nutrient-rich water solution without any soil.

question.q: New laws aim to reduce the ________ of greenhouse gases from factories.
question.justification: السيارات تقلل الانبعاثات (emissions) بالفلاتر. الدخل (incomes) والأسعار (prices) والضوضاء (noise) ليست ما تقلله الفلاتر.
question.context_sentence: New laws aim to reduce the ________ of greenhouse gases from factories.

question.q: The stadium has a seating ________ of over 80,000 spectators.
question.justification: الخزان له سعة (capacity) كبيرة. الوزن (weight) والحجم (size) واللون (color) خصائص أخرى.
question.context_sentence: The stadium has a seating ________ of over 80,000 spectators.

question.q: The entire city lost power because of a failure in the national ________.
question.justification: الألواح الشمسية تغذي شبكة الكهرباء (grid). الطريق (road) والهاتف (phone) والماء (water) ليست أنظمة طاقة.
question.context_sentence: The entire city lost power because of a failure in the national ________.
